# TikTok Auto-Posting Machine — Code Map

*Complete inventory of every Python module in the repository. Generated by Phase 1 Reality Audit.*

---

## Scripts Directory (`/scripts/`)

### Primary Entry Points

| File | Lines | Type | Status | Description |
|------|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| `orchestrator.py` | 274 | **Primary entry point** | **PRODUCTION** | Main autonomous scheduler (systemd service). 2h ±30min loop, quiet hours 2-6 AM MYT. Coordinates: sync → quality gate → video_processor → uploader → sync_out → daily jobs. |
| `upload_orchestrator.py` | 604 | Entry point | **DUPLICATE/LEGACY** | Old orchestrator with similar responsibilities. Contains Telegram bot integration. Not used by systemd. Should be removed. |
| `telegram_bot.py` | 585 | Background service | **PRODUCTION** | Telegram bot interface (polling thread). Commands: `/status`, `/growth`, `/stock`, `/captions`, `/pause`, `/resume`, `/force`, `/logs`, `/relogin`. Started by orchestrator. |
| `server.py` (webapp) | 683 | Entry point | **PRODUCTION** | FastAPI web backend + static file serving. Runs as `tiktok-webapp.service`. Endpoints: `/api/status`, `/api/config`, `/api/posts`, `/api/captions`, `/api/products`, `/api/events`, `/api/actions/*`. |

### Pipeline Modules (Called by Orchestrator)

| File | Lines | Type | Status | Description |
|------|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| `video_processor.py` | 648 | Pipeline stage | **PRODUCTION** | Core video transformation. One burn per run. FFmpeg + Skia overlay (8 styles). Randomization: speed, brightness, contrast, trim, overlay Y. Quality guards (frames≥10, MB/s≥0.30). Archives raw, writes sidecars, DB ledger. |
| `uploader.py` | 313 | Pipeline stage | **PRODUCTION** | Resilient upload. Proxy shorthand parsing + masked logging. Pre-upload geo-check (~2KB). Strict mode abort on bad proxy. NO retry on proxy transport errors. Retry on TikTok API failures. Sidecar-driven (skips bare mp4s). Flock lock. |
| `sync_drive.py` | 197 | Pipeline stage | **PRODUCTION** | Google Drive → local via rclone copy (not sync). Excludes processed/failed/posted. Updates DB raw_stock. Returns stock report for Telegram. |
| `sync_out.py` | 158 | Pipeline stage | **PRODUCTION** | Post-upload: push logs+processed to GDrive, then delete posted raws from GDrive via DB ledger. Cosmetic cleanup only (DB is source of truth). |
| `check_burns.py` | 156 | Quality gate | **PRODUCTION** | ffprobe scan of upload queue. Quarantines <10 frame burns to failed/. Exit code 1 if issues found (gates deploy). Also audits burn_log.jsonl. |

### Compliance & Caption System

| File | Lines | Type | Status | Description |
|------|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| `caption_policy.py` | 515 | Library | **PRODUCTION** | Battle-tested regex lexicon. HYPE_TERMS (obfuscate) vs PROHIBITED_PATTERNS (reject). Phonetic obfuscation (murah→mughrahh). Medical substitution repair. Caption length clamping (70 chars, 2 lines). Dedup key ignoring obfuscation. |
| `compliance.py` | 179 | Pipeline wrapper | **PRODUCTION** | Merged two-layer engine: Layer 1 = caption_policy regex (fast), Layer 2 = AI context-aware (optional). Obfuscation = anti-spam only, NOT compliance license. Returns (final_text, is_compliant, issues). |
| `compliance_engine.py` | 516 | Alternative impl | **DUPLICATE/LEGACY** | Separate AI-first compliance engine with batch checking. Used by telegram_bot.py and webapp. Duplicate of compliance.py with different API. |

### AI & Analytics

| File | Lines | Type | Status | Description |
|------|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| `ai_growth.py` | 537 | Daily job / CLI | **PRODUCTION** | Cached AI growth engine. ≤1 paid call/day (MYT). Free fallback pool. Writes growth_report.txt + updates preset_text.txt. Called by `/growth` and daily job. |
| `competitor_scraper.py` | 266 | Daily job | **PRODUCTION** | Apify clockworks/tiktok-scraper. Batch profiles in one run. Writes: competitor_videos, competitor_daily (analytics), competitor_data (legacy dashboard). |
| `generate_report.py` | 162 | Daily job | **PRODUCTION** | OPS report: quality check, stock levels, posted last N days, performance metrics. Writes daily_report.txt. Pure data, no AI. |
| `reconcile_metrics.py` | 168 | Daily job | **PRODUCTION** | Matches local uploads (videos) to scraped metrics (competitor_videos where handle=own). Strategies: tiktok_video_id → caption match ±36h → closest time. Populates daily_metrics. |
| `ai_engine.py` | 328 | Library | **LEGACY/DUPLICATE** | Older AI caption/strategy generator. Used by telegram_bot.py. Duplicate of ai_growth.py functionality. |

### Infrastructure & Shared

| File | Lines | Type | Status | Description |
|------|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| `lib.py` | 859 | **Core shared** | **PRODUCTION** | Config loading (YAML + env), path resolution, MYT timezone, DB connection (WAL), raw_stock ledger, quality floors, proxy parsing/geo-check, stock scanning, burn log, analytics helpers. **Everything imports this.** |
| `db.py` | 448 | **Core shared** | **PRODUCTION** | SQLite wrapper class. Schema: posts, raw_stock, caption_pool, competitor_data, system_events. Migration logic. Convenience methods for all tables. |
| `sidecar_manager.py` | 117 | Utility | **PRODUCTION** | Read/write/cleanup .json + .pid sidecars for upload queue. .json = full metadata, .pid = legacy product_id\|title\|caption. |
| `transform_video.py` | 867 | Library | **PRODUCTION** | 8 TikTok-native overlay styles (Skia primary, Playwright fallback). TextRenderer class. Malay caption builder (hooks/CTAs/emojis). FFmpeg encoding constants. |
| `setup_tools.py` | 247 | Utility | **PRODUCTION** | Config verification, DB init, seed captions, proxy test. Run manually during setup. |
| `import_cookies.py` | 169 | Utility | **PRODUCTION** | Browser cookie JSON/Netscape → TiktokAU pickle format. Extracts sessionid + tt-target-idc. |
| `qr_login.py` | 308 | Utility | **PRODUCTION** | Headless Playwright QR login. Routes through proxy (critical for IP consistency). Saves cookies to TiktokAU format. |

## TiktokAutoUploader Directory (`/TiktokAutoUploader/`)

### Upload Engine (Used by Orchestrator)

| File | Lines | Type | Status | Description |
|------|-------|------|--------|-------------|
| `tiktok_uploader/tiktok_v2.py` | 478 | **Core engine** | **PRODUCTION** | Current `upload_video()` with product anchors (type=33, add_from=2). TikTok web API flow: create project → upload chunks (AWS SigV4) → commit → publish with X-Bogus/_signature from Node.js. |
| `tiktok_uploader/tiktok.py` | 486 | Legacy engine | **LEGACY** | Old `upload_video()` without product anchors. Kept for compatibility. |
| `tiktok_uploader/Browser.py` | ~200 | Login only | **PRODUCTION** | Undetected-chromedriver wrapper. Shared by CLI login and noVNC. `wait_for_session_cookies()` polls for sessionid + tt-target-idc. |
| `tiktok_uploader/cookies.py` | ~100 | Utility | **PRODUCTION** | Pickle load/save for cookie files in CookiesDir/. |
| `tiktok_uploader/Config.py` | 131 | Config | **PRODUCTION** | Parses config.txt (COOKIES_DIR, VIDEOS_DIR, TIKTOK_VIDEO_SIZE, etc.). Singleton pattern. |
| `tiktok_uploader/bot_utils.py` | 135 | Utility | **PRODUCTION** | Node.js signature generation (subprocess_jsvmp), hashtag/@ parsing, CRC32, AWS SigV4 helpers. |
| `tiktok_uploader/tiktok_signature/` | Node.js | External | **PRODUCTION** | Playwright-based browser.js for X-Bogus/_signature generation. `npm install` + `playwright install chromium` required. |
